content:
mike: Quick sync — we're greenlit to stand up a new GPU project in ap-southeast-4 next Tuesday. Goal: dedicated prod pool (H100) + shared infra (VPC, NAT, endpoints). Who's on preflight?

tara: I'll lead cloud-account + VPC scaffold. Need the CIDR plan from networking.

jen: I can handle quota requests for GPUs and GCE quotas, and open the support cases. Do we have preferred SKUs? H100-80 or H100-40?

mike: Start with H100-40 for predictability. We'll request burst capacity for two extra nodes for initial stress tests. Jen, please request both GPU quota and regional CPUs to match.

alex: Quick checklist I want validated before Terraform apply: billing account linked, organization policies (no external IPs on workers), KMS key ready, and service accounts provisioned with least privilege.

tara: Noted. For VPC: tentative CIDR 10.140.0.0/16 for prod, 10.141.0.0/16 for shared-services. Avoid overlap with customer VPC ranges (ask solutions team). Any objections?

jen: Sounds good. I'll also ask for project-level quota increase for 10000 persistent disks IOPS — we saw spikes during model load tests.

mike: Add a NAT sizing note: we need at least 80 ephemeral SNAT ports per worker to avoid TCP exhaustion during model pulls. Put that in the runbook.

alex: Also reminder: enable flow logs on subnets and add a VPC endpoint for artifact registry/metadata.

infra-bot: Automated check: terraform workspace exists? NO. iam bindings present? PARTIAL. kms key present? NO.

mike: Thanks infra-bot. Tara, when you create the workspace, tag it with team=eng-runtime and env=prod. Include the Jira link in the workspace description: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INFRA-4820

tara: Will do. For handoff, I want oncall and runtime leads in the Handoff doc. Drafting a small runbook with validation steps:
1) Billing + IAM link verified
2) Quotas in place and support cases closed
3) CIDR & peering conflicts checked
4) Terraform apply in staging workspace (dry-run + plan output)
5) Smoke create one node pool with no GPUs and verify networking
6) Create GPU node pool and run model-load test (30m)
7) Observe metrics (GPU mem, NVLink, PCIe errors) + latency SLOs
8) Confirm autoscaler policy and scale-down grace period
9) Confirm fallback routing (route to eu-prod) if capacity shortage

jen: Add cost guardrail: set budget alert at $5k/day for first week and an autoscale cap to avoid runaway spend. Also enable per-resource labels for chargeback (project, cluster, component).

alex: For security/compliance: require customer-managed KMS key; disable metadata server access from pods; ensure node auto-upgrades are allowed only in maintenance windows.

mike: Good. Also add a note about regional GPU limits — cloud sometimes throttles allocations > 32 GPUs on first request. Plan staged provisioning (8 -> 16 -> 32) and confirm with cloud TAM.

tara: I'll queue a pre-provisioning call with cloud TAM tomorrow 10:30 PT. Who from SRE should join? @sre-oncall?

sre-oncall: I'll be there. Can we include log and trace retention plan? suggest 14d for high-res traces, 90d for aggregated metrics.

jen: I've opened the quota tickets and linked the runbook: https://docs.redwood.internal/runbooks/ap-se4-provisioning (draft). Ticket IDs: GCP-78912, GCP-78913.

infra-bot: Check complete set: quotas requested, workspace created, KMS pending, support call scheduled.

mike: Action items: Tara (VPC+workspace + runbook final), Jen (quotas + cost controls), Alex (IAM + KMS), SRE (monitoring retention + smoke playbook). Aim to freeze plan EOD tomorrow.

tara: I'll post the runbook draft in #eng-infra when ready and ping leads for review. :thumbsup:

jen: Will follow up on the quota escalation if no reply in 48h.

alex: I'll prepare the IAM policy snippet and service account list. snippet: ```json
{
  "bindings": [
    {"role":"roles/compute.viewer","members":["serviceAccount:runtime-sa@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com"]}
  ]
}
```

mike: Awesome. If no blockers, we proceed next Tue. Keep short updates here so we have the timeline recorded.

sre-oncall: I'll add an incident playbook for GPU OOMs and network flaps to the runbook.

tara: Draft is up: https://docs.redwood.internal/runbooks/ap-se4-provisioning (now includes CIDR, quotas, and handoff checklist). Please comment.

jen: LGTM from quota side.

mike: Closing the loop — thanks everyone. We'll reconvene Mon 9am PT for final go/no-go. :rocket:
